name: loongdun-vault
description: Offline personal credential and dependency vault

scripts.quality:commit: corepack pnpm test:hooks && corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm quality:fast && corepack pnpm format:rust:check && corepack pnpm lint:rust && corepack pnpm test:rust && corepack pnpm contract:check && corepack pnpm legal:check && corepack pnpm change:check
scripts.quality:fast: corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test
scripts.quality: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm format:rust:check && corepack pnpm lint:rust && corepack pnpm test:rust && corepack pnpm contract:check && corepack pnpm legal:check && corepack pnpm migration:check && corepack pnpm build:rust:check && corepack pnpm build
scripts.quality:full: corepack pnpm quality && corepack pnpm security:audit && corepack pnpm deploy:preflight
scripts.security:audit: corepack pnpm audit --prod --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ && cargo audit --file src-tauri/Cargo.lock
scripts.deploy:preflight: corepack pnpm quality && corepack pnpm tauri build --debug --no-bundle
